job.value: Set the notification Shoutout's audience size and post it

arrivedFrom.value: 'Next' on Create Shoutout: Notification or email

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Set audience size' with a '1,000' slider and 'Post Shoutout' is clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Post Shoutout' button with '200' coins is the primary.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Post Shoutout' and the slider labelled 'Min'/'Max' predict their effect.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'chatters' is an odd term, and 'Biz' badge is unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Audience size is a choice, but 'your max audience may vary each time' means the seller can't predict what the number buys.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the slider, one explanation and cost are shown.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All of it is about sizing and paying for this Shoutout.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The slider carries it, but the paragraph 'We'll send your Shoutout to your most engaged buyers...' needs reading to know what 1,000 means; the value also shows twice ('1,000' and '1000' tooltip).
